operations.description: Updates the survey's `name` and/or `is_archived` flag — nothing else is patchable here; questions change only through the replace-questions call. Archiving (`is_archived: true`) is the survey's soft delete: there is deliberately no DELETE route, because archiving preserves the answers already collected — a `DELETE` on this path is an unmatched route and answers 404 `Route not found`. Restore with

surveyId.description: Survey ID (BIGINT serialized as string in responses; send the numeric value).

name.description: New display name. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before validation, so a blank or whitespace-only name is rejected with 400 (`name should not be empty` in `subErrors`).

is_archived.description: `true` archives the survey (its soft delete), `false` restores it.

operations.name: Peek at the next contacts to be dialed
operations.description: Returns, in order, the contacts the allocator would serve next — a read-only, NON-BINDING snapshot. Nothing is held, locked or recorded, so any of these contacts may be taken by an agent a moment later; treat the answer as a display hint, never a reservation. There is no partner-facing way to claim a contact. A campaign that exists but is not active, or whose queue is empty, answers 200 with an em

count.description: How many contacts to peek at. Defaults to the campaign's `queue_policy.lock_size`.

operations.name: Replace a campaign's associations
operations.description: Replaces every association of the campaign in one call: the contact tags that define its membership (`target_tag`), the queue groups it draws agents from (`queue_group`), and the individually assigned agents (`agent`). Each array is optional and defaults to empty, so an omitted kind clears that kind. Entries can be given as objects or as bare ids — `[10, 11]` is shorthand for `[{ "ref_id": 10 }, {

target_tag.description: Contact tags that define the campaign's membership. Naming a CRM-connection-owned tag re-ranks it in place; adding or removing such a tag is owned by the CRM connection, not this call.

queue_group.description: Queue groups the campaign draws its agents from.

operations.name: Replace a campaign's disposition buttons
operations.description: Replaces the campaign's whole disposition-button set — the buttons an agent picks from to close a call. Each button references a call tag by `tag_id` (list them with the disposition-tags call) and declares the `outcome_kind` that tells the dialer what to do next (retry, reschedule, stop calling, …). An empty `buttons` array clears the set. The button's display name and colour are always taken from

buttons.description: The complete button set for the campaign. An empty array clears every button.

operations.name: Replace a survey's questions
operations.description: Atomically replaces the survey's entire question set — this is a replace, not a merge. The body is the desired end state: existing questions (and their options) are deleted and the provided set is inserted in one transaction, ordered by `display_order`. `{"questions": []}` is valid and clears the survey. Question and option ids are server-generated — never send them; every replace mints new ids. A

surveyId.description: Survey ID (BIGINT serialized as string in responses; send the numeric value).

operations.description: Creates an agent. `firstname`, `lastname`, `email` and `pass` are required. The optional fields allow outbound calling (`status_outbound`), cap daily call spend in EUR (`daily_price_limit`, 1–200), assign a four-digit `extension` that must be unique across the company (1000–9999), and set a default outbound number (`call_number_id`). Returns `201` with the new agent's ID; `403` means the account h

status_outbound.description: Does agent have outbound calls allowed?

daily_price_limit.description: Daily price limit for all calls in EUR. Usually allowed values are from 1 to 200 EUR. Leave empty for using default value.

extension.description: Extension of an agent. Extension must be four digits long and be unique across whole company.

operations.description: Add number to blacklist.

after_call_dialing_auto.description: Automatically dial next contact after a call ends true/false

The remaining scalar fields describe the company and postal address, and the `ContactNumber`, `ContactEmail`, `ContactsTag`, `ContactAttribute` and `ExternalUrl` arrays attach phone numbers, email addresses, tags, custom attribute values and links to external systems in the same request. Returns `201` with the new contact's ID. Note the core API creates

operations.description: Adds an agent to a group. Both `group_id` and `agent_id` are required and together identify the membership to create. Note the core API creates with `PUT`, not `POST`.
